notes.subject: chereme
notes.rationale: חרם: se šilo go tšwa go batho goba selo se se tloditšwego go ruiwa — ba fetoleli ba fapana magareng ga 'go ruiwa' le 'go ruiwa bakeng sa go senywa'.

notes.subject: חרם/יחרם
notes.rationale: Sefoko le se tšwa modumong o tee (chereme / go charema) — modumo o wa babja ga o phethagalale ka Sepedi.

notes.subject: מות יומת
notes.rationale: Seheberu se gatelela ka go boelediša 'lehu o tla hwa ka lona' — Sepedi se boelediša ka mokgwa o mongwe.

translation: Chereme ka moka, yeo e tlodilwego go tšwa bathong, ga e ka ke ya rekolwa; o tla bolawa — o tla hwa ka lehu.
